Name: Unicorn Horses
Author: FrostyQilin
Description:
[b]How to use

[/b]After installing [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ extract the folder in your mods folder. Use a text editor of your choice to edit the config.json file. Check the UnicornColors image in the ReferenceImages folder for available colors. Check the SaddleColors image in the same folder for the saddle colors or keep the value "None" for no saddle. For a long mane or horse tail, change the value in the corresponding fields to "true", otherwise "false".

Alternativley you can use the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to easily set your preferences in-game.


[b]Features

[/b][list]
[*]8 different colors for your unicorn
[*]7 different saddle colors
[*]Option to remove saddle completely
[*]Option to choose between a horse tail and a unicorn-ish tail
[*]Optional longer mane
[/list]


[b](Possible) future updates

[/b][list]
[*]More colors for unicorns and saddles
[*]Adjustable horn color
[*]Prettier sprites
[/list]
